propositions: Merge-abort recovery logic is duplicated across sync.py and push_recovery.py with divergent implementations of the quarantine mover
sync._quarantine_untracked lacks the tracked-file safety fence (git status ?? check) that push_recovery._quarantine_untracked_paths implements, creating parity bugs in two code paths

The toolkit (abort parser, quarantine arithmetic, mover, local-change restore) must be unified into a single merge_recovery.py module that accepts git as a callable so both module-level and late-bound git runners work without losing monkeypatch points

push_recovery currently imports shared functions from sync under a seven-line comment explaining why the mover cannot be shared, but the reason only applies to git calls, not the pure parser or the mover logic itself
doctor.py calls sync._quarantine_untracked directly, making the untracked-fence convergence a three-way change affecting sync, push_recovery, and doctor

Exactly one quarantine mover and one merge-abort parser must exist in src/rebar, verified by guard construction requiring a shutil.move/copy2 call paired with a mandatory quarantine-move-ok reason comment
